entities.name: Gavon Deniz
entities.description: The Benalish lord of Alric's Landing in Shiv who schemed to frame Darigaaz and seize the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Alric's Landing
entities.description: A Benalish holding on Shiv ruled by Gavon Deniz.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The dragon-ruled region of Dominaria where Deniz brought troops.

entities.name: Ghitu
entities.description: The people Deniz claimed his troops would help.

entities.name: Omek
entities.description: A goblin king who traded goblins to Deniz for Benalish swords.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin killed by Deniz who did not stay dead, later helping to reclaim the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: A dragon framed by Deniz for the deaths of his soldiers.

entities.name: Keltaz
entities.description: A dragon controlled by an artifact to attack Benalish soldiers.

entities.name: Kyashatar
entities.description: A dragon whose brood favored Deniz after Darigaaz was framed.

entities.name: Red-haired planeswalker
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Deniz frame Darigaaz.

entities.name: Adeliz
entities.description: An ally of Squee and Darigaaz in the campaign to reclaim the Mana Rig.

entities.name: The Traveler
entities.description: The Magic: Legends planeswalker who joined the campaign and dispatched Deniz.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: A contraption that produces powerstones, captured by Deniz.

entities.name: Markolf Deniz
entities.description: Gavon Deniz's son and successor as lord of Alric's Landing.

entities.name: Old Onkoom
entities.description: A Ghitu settlement raided by pressed goblins.

events.summary: Deniz traded Benalish swords to the goblin king Omek for a few hundred goblins; Omek later cut off the trade.
events.quote: Deniz made a deal with the goblin king Omek

events.summary: Deniz met the red-haired planeswalker, who helped him frame Darigaaz; Deniz put Darigaaz into an unconscious state while Keltaz was controlled to attack Benalish soldiers.
events.quote: Deniz met the red-haired planeswalker , who helped him frame Darigaaz .

events.summary: Deniz killed several goblins who might have overheard the conspiracy, including Squee.
events.quote: Deniz killed several goblins who might have heard him discussing the conspiracy

events.summary: Deniz had Darigaaz framed for the deaths of his soldiers and demanded his arrest before the Shivan Council, winning the favor of Kyashatar and her brood.
events.quote: Deniz had Darigaaz framed for the deaths of his soldiers

events.summary: Deniz captured and activated the Mana Rig to produce powerstones.
events.quote: Deniz captured the contraption and activated it

events.summary: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz and the Traveler to reclaim the Mana Rig; the Traveler dispatched Deniz at the rig's helm.
events.quote: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz , and the Traveler in a campaign to reclaim the Mana Rig.

events.summary: Markolf Deniz succeeded his father as lord of Alric's Landing.
events.quote: The lord of Alric's Landing was succeeded by his son Markolf Deniz.

relations.quote: Gavon Deniz was the Benalish lord of Alric's Landing in Shiv .

relations.note: Markolf is his son and successor.
relations.quote: The lord of Alric's Landing was succeeded by his son Markolf Deniz.
